====Secure Luxury Motorcoach Service====
In August 2024, [[American Airlines]] began offering connecting luxury motorcoaches to/from [[Philadelphia International Airport]] from/to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton International Airport. The service is ticketed and operated as an airline flight but utilizes luxury motorcoaches, given Philadelphia's close proximity to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton and available connections as a major hub for American Airlines. This airside-to-airside service, which is solely for screened passengers who booked a seat on the route, is operated by American's bus service partner, Landline, on American's behalf.{{cn|date=July 2026}}
